title: In l2c_fcr_process_peer_cfg_req of l2c_fcr.cc, there is a possible memory safety issue due to an… (CVE-2026-58990)
description: CVE-2026-58990 is a memory safety vulnerability in the function l2c_fcr_process_peer_cfg_req within l2c_fcr.cc caused by an integer overflow. This flaw could allow remote attackers to disclose information without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
